# YachtVersal

> YachtVersal is a yacht marketplace at https://yachtversal.com for buying, selling, and chartering yachts. Buyers browse and contact sellers for free; verified yacht brokers and private sellers list vessels with no transaction fees or sales commissions.

Key facts:
- Buying, searching, saving yachts, price alerts, and contacting sellers are free for buyers.
- Brokers pay a one-time setup fee for full platform access with unlimited active listings; there are no per-sale commissions.
- Listings include full specifications, photos, video, PDF documents, a finance calculator, and direct broker contact.
- Yacht charters are listed with day/weekly rates, crew details, and operating regions.

## Buy

- [Yachts for sale](https://yachtversal.com/listings): All current listings, filterable by boat type, make, model, price, length, year, condition, and location.
- [AI yacht search](https://yachtversal.com/ai-search): Describe the boat you want in plain English and get matched listings.
- [Boat types guide](https://yachtversal.com/boat-types): What each boat category (motor yacht, sailing yacht, catamaran, trawler, sport fisher, and more) is built for, who it suits, and which builders make it.
- [Boat makes directory](https://yachtversal.com/makes): Builders and their model ranges.
- [How buying works](https://yachtversal.com/resources/how-buying-works): The yacht buying process step by step.
- [Financing guide](https://yachtversal.com/resources/financing): How marine lending works.

## Charter

- [Yacht charters](https://yachtversal.com/charter): Yachts available for charter with rates and regions.
- [Charter destinations](https://yachtversal.com/charter-destinations): Cruising region guides with conditions, highlights, and available yachts.

## Sell

- [For yacht brokers](https://yachtversal.com/sell/brokers): Broker listing plans and tools, including AI listing import and team management.
- [For private sellers](https://yachtversal.com/sell/private): Private seller listing plans.
- [Yacht broker directory](https://yachtversal.com/dealers): Verified broker profiles and their listings.

## Support

- [FAQ](https://yachtversal.com/faq): Answers about buying, chartering, selling, pricing, and security.
- [Contact](https://yachtversal.com/contact): Reach the YachtVersal team.
- [Blog](https://yachtversal.com/blog): Guides and market articles.
